After adminCreatePagePreviewToken the preview shows one antd QRCode (type svg, no icon, role=img with a dictionary label) encoding couli://r/HomePreview?page_key=<encodeURIComponent>&token=<token> (scheme couli per 06 Q-A5, shape per 03 §4.4, routes.json HomePreview has no host); the prefix is a single const in model.ts; the preview state is cleared before every issue so a failed (re)issue shows no QR. The placeholder copy and the 'no QR code' header comment are gone (frozen admin-home-config preview / source tests take their new branch, F1-09ut #2596). Error rate = error_count / render_count with BigInt integer rounding to at most 2 decimals, trailing zeros dropped; render_count 0 shows the dash.
